# brute-force minimum-area rectangle from convex hull edges
def min_rot_rect(points):
    P = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
    hull = MultiPoint(P.tolist()).convex_hull
    # get hull coords
    if hull.geom_type == 'Polygon':
        coords = np.array(hull.exterior.coords[:-1])
    else:
        coords = np.array(hull.coords[:-1] if hasattr(hull,'coords') else hull.coords)
    best_area = None
    best = None
    n = len(coords)
    for i in range(n):
        p1 = coords[i]
        p2 = coords[(i+1)%n]
        edge = p2 - p1
        angle = np.arctan2(edge[1], edge[0])
        R = np.array([[np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)],[-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)]])
        rot = P @ R.T
        mn = rot.min(axis=0)
        mx = rot.max(axis=0)
        w = mx[0]-mn[0]
        h = mx[1]-mn[1]
        area = w*h
        if best_area is None or area < best_area:
            best_area = area
            best = (angle, mn, mx, w, h)
    return best_area, best
